verses: Taa Haa
Hum ney yeh Quran tujh per uss liye nahi utara kay to mushaqqat mein parr jaye
Balkay)yeh uss ki naseehat kay liye jo Allah say darta hai
Uss ka utarna uss ki taraf say hai jiss ney zamin ko aur buland aasmano ko peda kiya hai
Jo rehman hai, arsh per qaeem hai
Jiss ki milkiyat aasmano aur zamin aur unn dono kay darmiyan aur (kurah khak) kay neechay ki her aik cheez per hai
Agar to unchi baat kahey to woh to her aik posheedah, balkay)yeh posheedah say posheedah tar cheez ko bhi bakhoobi janta hai
O hi Allah hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, behtareen naam ussi kay hain
Tujhay Musa (alaihi as-salam) ka qissa bhi maloom hai?

Jabkay uss ney aag dekh ker apney ghar walon say kaha kay tum zara si dare thehar jao mujhay aag dikhaee di hai. Boht mumkin hai kay mein uss ka koi angara tumharay pass laon ya aag kay pass say raastay ki itlaa paon
Jab woh o haan phonchay to awaz di gaee aey Musa
Yaqeenan mein hi tera perwerdigar hun to apni jootiyan utaar dey, kyunkay to pak maidan tua mein hai
Aur mein ney tujhay muntakhib ker liya abb jo wahee ki jaye ussay kaan laga ker sunn
Be-shak mein hi Allah hun, meray siwa ibadat kay laeeq aur koi nahi pus to meri hi ibadat ker, aur meri yaad kay liye namaz qaeem rakh
Qayamat yaqeenan aaney wali hai jissay mein posheedah rakhna chahata hun takay her shakhs ko woh badla diya jaye jo uss ney koshish ki ho
Pus abb uss kay yaqeen say tujhay koi aisa shakhs rok na dey jo uss per eman na rakhta ho aur apni khuwahish kay peechay para ho, werna to halak hojaye ga
Aey Musa! teray uss dayen hath mein kiya hai?
Jawab diya kay yeh meri laathi hai, jiss per mein take lagata hun aur jiss say mein apni bakriyon kay liye pattay jhaar liya kerta hun aur bhi uss mein mujhay boht say faeeday hain
Farmaya aey Musa! ussay hath say neechay daal dey
Daaltay hi woh saanp bann ker dorney lagi
Farmaya bey khof ho ker ussay pakar ley, hum ussay ussi pehli si soorat mein doobara laa den gay
Aur apna hath apni baghal mein daal ley to woh safaid chamakta hua ho ker niklay ga, lekin baghair kissi aib (aur rog) kay yeh doosra moajza hai
Yeh uss liye kay hum tujhay apni bari bari nishaniyan dikhana chahatay hain
Abb to Firaun ki taraf jaa uss ney bari sirkashi macha rakhi hai
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha aey meray perwerdigar! mera seena meray liye khol dey
Aur meray kaam ko mujh per aasan ker dey
Aur meri zaban ki girah bhi khol dey
Takay log meri baat achi tarah samajh saken
Aur mera wazir meray kunbay mein say ker dey
Yani meray bhai Haroon (alaihi as-salam) ko
To uss say meri kamar kiss dey
Aur ussay mera shareek kaar ker dey
Takay hum dono ba-kasrat teri tasbeeh biyan keren
Aur ba-kasrat teri yaad keren
Be-shak to humen khoob dekhney bhalney wala hai
Janab bari Taalaa ney farmaya Musa teray tamam sawalaat pooray ker diye gaye
Hum ney to tujh per baar aur bhi bara ehsan kiya hai
Jabkay hum ney teri maa ko woh elhaam kiya jiss ka zikar abb kiya jaa raha hai

Kay to ussay sandooq mein band kerkay darya mein chor dey, pus darya ussay kinaray laa dalay ga aur mera aur khud uss ka dushman ussay ley ley ga, aur mein ney apni taraf ki khaas mohabbat mohabbat-o-maqbooliyat tujh per daal di. Takay teri perwerish meri aankhon kay samney ki jaye

(yaad ker) jabkay teri behan chal rahi thi aur keh rahi thi kay agar tum kaho to mein ussay bata doon jo uss ki nigehbani keray, uss tadbeer say hum ney tujhay phir teri maa kay pass phonchaya kay uss ki aankhen thandi rahen aur woh ghumgeen na ho. Aur tu ney aik shakhs ko maar dala tha uss per bhi hum ney tujhay ghum say bacha liya, gharz hum ney tujhay achi tarah aazma liya. Phir to kaee saal tak madiyan kay logon mein thehra raha, phir taqdeer-e-elahee elahi kay mutabiq aey Musa! to aaya
Aur mein ney tujhay khaas apni zaat kay liye pasand farma liya
Abb to apney bhai samet meri nishaniyan humrah liye huye jaa, aur khabardaar meray zikar mein susti na kerna
Tum dono Firaun kay pass jao uss ney bari sirkashi ki hai
Ussay narmi say samjhao kay shayad woh samajh ley ya darr jaye
Dono ney kaha aey humaray rab! humen khof hai kay kahen Firaun hum per koi ziyadti na keray ya apni sirkashi mein barh na jaye
Jawab mila kay tum mutlaqan khof na kero mein tumharay sath hun aur sunta dekhta rahon ga

Tum uss kay pass jaa ker kaho kay hum teray perwerdigar kay payghumbar hain to humaray sath bani israeel ko bhej dey, unn ki sazayen moqoof ker. Hum to teray pass teray rab ki taraf say nishani ley ker aaye hain aur salamti ussi kay liye hai jo hidayat ka paband ho jaye
Humari taraf wahee ki gaee hai kay jo jhutlaye aur roo-gardani keray uss kay liye azab hai
Firaun ney poocha kay aey Musa tum dono ka rab kaun hai?
Jawab diya kay humara rab woh hai jiss ney her aik ko uss ki khaas soorat, shakal inayat farmaee phir raah sujha di
Uss ney kaha acha yeh to batao aglay zamaney walon ka haal kiya hona hai
Jawab diya kay unn ka ilm meray rab kay haan kitab mein mojood hai, na to mera rab ghalati kerta hai na bhoolta hai

Ussi ney tumharay liye zamin ko farash banaya hai aur uss mein tumharay chalney kay liye raastay banaye hain aur aasman say pani bhi o hi barsata hai, phir uss barsaat ki wajah say mukhtalif qasam ki paidawaar bhi hum hi peda kertay hain
Tum khud khao aur apney chopayon ko bhi charao. Kuch shak nahi kay uss mein aqalmandon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain
Ussi zamin mein say hum ney tumhen peda kiya aur ussi mein phir wapis lotayen gay aur ussi say phir doobara tum sab ko nikal khara keren gay
Hum ney apni sab nishaniyan dikha den lekin phir bhi uss ney jhutlaya aur inkar ker diya
Kehney laga aey Musa! kiya to ussi liye aaya hai kay humen apney jadoo kay zor say humaray mulk say bahir nikal dey

Acha hum bhi teray muqablay mein ussi jaisa jadoo zaroor layen gay pus to humaray aur apney darmiyan aik waday ka waqt muqarrar ker ley, kay na hum uss ka khilaf keren aur na to, saaf maidan mein muqabla ho
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney jawab diya kay zeenat aur jashan kay din ka wada hai aur yeh kay log din charhay hi jama ho jayen
Pus Firaun lot gaya aur uss ney apney hathkanday jama kiye phir aagaya

Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney unn say kaha tumhari shamat chuki, Allah Taalaa per jhoot aur iftra na bandho kay woh tumhen azabon say maliya mait ker dey, yaad rakho woh kabhi kaamyaab na hoga jiss ney jhooti baat ghari
Pus yeh log aapas kay mashwaron mein mukhtalif raye hogaye aur chup ker chupkay chupkay mashwara kerney lagay
Kehney lagay yeh dono mehaz jadoogar hain aur unn ka pukhta iradah hai kay apney jadoo kay zor say tumhen tumharay mulk say nikal bahir ker den aur tumharay behtareen mazhab ko barbaad ker den
To tum bhi apna koi dao utha na rakho, phir saff bandi kerkay aao. Jo ghalib aagaya o hi baazi ley gaya
Kehney lagay kay aey Musa! ya to to pehlay daal ya hum pehlay dalney walay bann jayen
Jawab diya kay nahi tum hi pehlay dalo. Abb to Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko yeh khayal guzarney laga kay unn ki rasiyan aur lakriyan unn kay jadoo kay zor say dor bhaag rahi hain
Pus Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney apney dil hi dil mein darr mehsoos kiya
Hum ney farmaya kuch khof na ker yaqeenan to hi ghalib aur bartar rahey ga

Aur teray dayen hath mein jo hai ussay daal kay unn ki tamam karigari ko woh nigal jaye, unhon ney jo kuch banaya hai yeh sirf jadoogaron kay kartab hain aur jadoogar kahen say bhi aaye kaamyaab nahi hota
Abb to tamam jadoogar sajday mein gir paray aur pukar uthay kay hum to Haroon aur Musa (alaihima as-salam) kay rab per eman laye

Firaun kehney laga kay kiya meri ijazat say pehlay hi tum uss per eman ley aaye? Yaqeenan yehi tumhara woh bara buzurg hai jiss ney tum sab ko jadoo sikhaya hai, (sunn lo) mein tumharay paon ultay seedhay katwa ker tum sab ko khajoor kay tano mein sooli per latakwa doon ga, aur tumhen poori tarah maloom hojaye ga kay hum mein say kiss ki maar ziyadah sakht aur dairpaa hai

Unhon ney jawab diya kay na-mumkin hai kay hum tujhay tarjeeh den unn daleelon per jo humaray samney chukin aur uss Allah per jiss ney humen peda kiya hai abb to to jo kuch kerney o laa hai ker guzar, to jo kuch bhi hukum chala sakta hai woh ussi dunyawi zindagi mein hi hai

Hum (uss umeed say) apney perwerdigar per eman laye kay woh humari khatayen moaf farma dey aur (khaas ker) kadoogari (ka gunah,) jiss per tum ney humen majboor kiya hai, Allah hi behtar aur hamesha baqi rehney wala hai
Baat yehi hai kay jo bhi gunehgar bann ker Allah Taalaa kay haan hazir hoga uss kay liye dozakh hai, jahan na maut hogi aur na zindagi
Aur jo bhi uss kay pass eman ki halat mein hazir hoga aur uss ney aemaal bhi nek kiye hun gay uss kay liye buland bala darjay hain
Hameshgi wali jannaten jin kay neechay nehren lehren ley rahi hain jahan woh hamesha (hamesha) rahen gay. Yehi inam hai her uss shakhs ka jo pak hua

Hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki taraf wahee nazil farmaee kay to raaton raat meray bandon ko ley chal, aur unn kay liye darya mein khushk raasta bana ley, phir na tujhay kissi kay pakarney ka khatra hoga na darr
Firaun ney apney lashkaron samet unn ka taaqqub kiya phir to darya unn sab per cha gaya jaisa kuch cha janey wala tha
Firaun ney apni qom ko gumrahi mein daal diya aur seedha raasta na dikhaya
Aey bani israeel! dekho hum ney tumhen tumharay dushman say nijat di aur tum say koh tor ki dayen taraf ka wada kiya aur tum per mann o salwa utara
Tum humari di hui pakeezah rozi khao, aur uss mein hadd say aagay na barho, werna tum per mera ghazab nazil hoga, aur jiss per mera ghazab nazil ho jaye woh yaqeenan tabah hua
Haan be-shak mein unhen bakhsh denay wala hun jo tauba keren eman layen nek amal keren aur raah raast per bhi rahen
Aey Musa! tujhay apni qom say (ghafil kerkay) kaun si cheez jaldi ley aaee?
Kaha kay woh log bhi meray peechay hi peechay hain, aur mein ney aey rab! teri taraf jaldi uss liye ki kay to khush ho jaye
Farmaya! hum ney teri qom ko teray peechay aazmaeesh mein daal diya aur unhen samri ney behka diya hai

Pus Musa (alaihi as-salam) sakht ghazab ho ker ranj kay sath wapis lotay, aur kehney lagay kay aey meri qom walo! kiya tum say tumharay perwerdigar ney nek wada nahi kiya tha? Kiya uss ki muddat tumhen lambi maloom hui? Balkay)yeh tumhara iradah hi yeh hai kay tum per tumharay perwerdigar ka ghazab nazil ho? Kay tum ney meray waday ka khilaf kiya

Unhon ney jawab diya kay hum ney ikhtiyar say aap kay sath waday ka khilaf nahi kiya. Balkay)yeh hum per zewraat qom kay jo bojh laad diye gaye thay unhen hum ney daal diya, aur ussi tarah samri ney bhi daal diye
Phir uss ney logon kay liye aik bachra nikal khara kiya yani bachray ka butt, jiss ki gaaye ki si awaz bhi thi phir kehney lagay kay yehi tumhara mabood hai aur Musa ka bhi, lekin Musa bhool gaya hai
Kiya yeh gumrah log yeh bhi nahi dekhtay kay woh to unn ki baat ka jawab bhi nahi dey sakta aur na unn kay kissi buray bhalay ka ikhtiyar rakhta hai

Aur Haroon (alaihi as-salam) ney uss say pehlay hi unn say keh diya tha aey meri qom walo! uss bachray say to sirf tumhari aazmaeesh ki gaee hai, tumhara haqeeqi perwerdigar to Allah rehman hi hai, pus tum sab meri tabeydaari kero. Aur meri baat mantay chalay jao
Unhon ney jawab diya kay Musa (alaihi as-salam) ki wapsi tak to hum ussi kay mujawar banay bethay rahen gay
Musa (alaihi as-salam) kehney lagay aey Haroon! unhen gumrah hota hua dekhtay huye tujhay kiss cheez ney roka tha
Kay to meray peechay na aaya. Kiya to bhi meray farman ka nafarman bann betha

Haroon (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha aey meray maa jaye bhai! meri darhi na pakar aur sir kay baal na khench, mujhay to sirf yeh khayal daman geer hua kay kahen aap yeh (na) farmaeen kay tu ney bani israeel mein tafarrqa daal diya aur meri baat ka intizar na kiya
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney poocha samri tera kiya moamla hai

Uss ney jawab diya kay mujhay woh cheez dikhaee di jo unhen dikhaee nahi di, to mein ney farstada-e-elahee elahi kay naqsh-e-paa qadam say aik muthi bhar li ussay uss mein daal diya ussi tarah meray dil ney yeh baat meray liye bhali bana di

Kaha acha jaa duniya ki zindagi mein teri saza yehi hai kay to kehta rahey kay mujhay na choona, aur aik aur bhi wada teray sath hai jo tujh say her gaz na talay ga, aur abb to apney uss mabood ko bhi dekh lena jiss ka aeytikaaf kiye huye tha kay hum ussay jila ker darya mein reza reza ura den gay
Asal baat yehi hai kay tum sab ka mabood bar-haq sirf Allah hi hai uss kay siwa koi parastish kay qabil nahi. Uss ka ilm tamam cheezon per hawi hai
Ussi tarah hum teray samney pehlay ki guzri hui waardaaten biyan farma rahey hain aur yaqeenan hum tujhay apney pass say naseehat ata farma chukay hain
Uss say jo mun pher ley ga woh yaqeenan qayamat kay din apna bhari bojh laaday huye hoga
Jiss mein hamesha hi rahey ga, aur unn kay liye qayamat kay din (bara) bura bojh hai
Jiss din soor phonka jaye ga aur gunah gaaron ko hum uss din (dehshat ki wajah say) neeli peeli aankhon kay sath gher layen gay
Woh aapas mein chupkay chupkay keh rahey hun gay kay hum to (duniya mein) sirf das din hi rahey
Kuch woh keh rahey hain uss ki haqeeqat say hum ba-khabar hain unn mein sab say ziyadah achi raah wala keh raha ho ga kay tum to sirf aik hi din rahey
Woh aap say paharon ki nisbat sawal kertay hain, to aap keh den kay unhen mera rab reza reza ker kay ura dey ga
Aur zamin ko bilkul humwaar saaf maidan ker kay choray ga
Jiss mein to na kahen mor dekhay ga na oonch neech
Jiss din log pukarney walay kay peechay chalen gay jiss mein koi kuji na hogi aur Allah rehman kay samney tamam aawazen pust ho jayen gi siwaye khusur phusur kay tujhay kuch bhi sunaee na dey ga
Uss din sifarish kuch kaam nahi aaye gi magar jissay rehman hukum dey aur uss ki baat ko pasand farmaye
Jo kuch unn kay aagay peechay hai ussay Allah hi janta hai makhlooq ka ilm uss per hawi nahi ho sakta
Tamam chehray uss zindah aur qaeem daeem mudabbir, Allah kay samney kamal aajzi say jhukay huye hongay, yaqeenan woh barbaad hua jiss ney zulm laad liya
Aur jo nek aemaal keray aur eman wala bhi ho to na ussay bey insafi ka khutka hoga na haq talfi ka
Ussi tarah hum ney tujh per arabi Quran nazil farmaya hai aur tarah tarah say uss mein darr ka biyan sunaya hai takay log perhez gaar bann jayen ya unn kay dil mein soch samajh to peda keray

Pus Allah aali shaan wala sacha aur haqeeqi badshah hai. To Quran parhney mein jaldi na ker uss say pehlay kay teri taraf jo wahee ki jati hai woh poori ki jaye, haan yeh dua ker kay perwerdigar! mera ilm barha
Hum ney Adam ko pehlay hi takeedi hukum diya tha lekin woh bhool gaya aur hum ney uss mein koi azum nahi paya
Aur jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay Adam (alaihi as-salam) ko sajdah kero to Iblees kay siwa sab ney kiya, uss ney saaf inkar ker diya
To hum ney kaha aey Adam! yeh tera aur teri biwi ka dushman hai (khayal rakhna) aisa na ho kay woh tum dono ko jannat say nikalwa dey kay to museebat mein parr jaye
Yahan to tujhay yeh aaram hai kay na to bhooka hota hai na nanga
Aur na to yahan piayasa hota hai na dhoop say takleef uthata hai
Lekin shetan ney ussay waswasa dala, kehney laga kay mein tujhay daeemi zindagi ka darakht aur badshahat batlaon kay jo kabhi purani na ho

Chunacha unn dono ney uss darakht say kuch kha liya pus unn kay satter khul gaye aur bahisht kay pattay apney upper taankney lagay. Adam (alaihi as-salam) ney apney rab ki na-farmani ki, pus behak gaya
Phir uss kay rab ney nawaza, uss ki tauba qabool ki aur uss ki rehnumaee ki

Farmaya, tum dono yahan utar jao tum aapas mein aik doosray kay dushman ho, abb tumharay pass kabhi meri taraf say hidayat phonchay to jo meri hidayat ki pairwee keray na to woh behkay ga na takleef mein paray ga
Aur (haan) jo meri yaad say roo-gardani keray ga uss ki zindagi tangi mein rahey gi, aur hum ussay baroz qayamat andha ker kay uthayen gay
Woh kahey ga kay elahi! mujhay tu ney andha bana ker kiyon uthaya? Halankay mein to dekhta bhalta tha
(jawab milay ga kay) ussi tarah hona chahaiye tha to meri aaee hui aayaton ko bhool gaya to aaj to bhi bhala diya jata hai
Hum aisa hi badla her uss shakhs ko diya kertay hain jo hadd say guzar jaye aur apney rab ki aayaton per eman na laye, aur be-shak aakhirat ka azab nihayat hi sakht aur baqi rehney wala hai

Kiya unn ki rehbari uss baat ney bhi nahi ki kay hum ney unn say pehlay boht si bastiyan halak ker di hain jin kay rehney sehney ki jagah yeh chal phir rahey hain. Yaqeenan uss mein aqalmandon kay liye boht si nishaniyan hain
Agar teray rab ki baat pehlay hi say muqarrar shuda aur waqt moyyen kerdah na hota to ussi waqt azab chimatta

Pus unn ki baaton per sabar ker aur apney perwerdigar ki tasbeeh aur tareef biyan kerta reh, sooraj nikalney say pehlay aur uss kay dobney say pehlay, raat kay mukhtalif waqton mein bhi aur din kay hisson mein bhi tasbeeh kerta reh, boht mumkin hai kay to razi ho jaye

Aur apni nigahen hergiz unn cheezon ki taraf na dorana jo hum ney unn mein say mukhtalif logon ko aaraeesh duniya ki dey rakhi hain takay unhen uss mein aazma len teray rab ka diya hua hi (boht) behtar aur baqi rehney wala hai
Apney gharaney kay logon namaz ki takeed rakh aur khud bhi uss per jama reh, hum tujh say rozi nahi mangtay, balkay)yeh hum khud tujhay rozi detay hain, aakhir mein bol bala perhezgari hi ka hai
Unhon ney kaha kay yeh nabi humaray pass apney perwerdigar ki taraf say koi nishani kiyon nahi laya? Kiya unn kay pass agli kitabon ki wazeh daleel nahi phonchi?

Aur agar hum uss say pehlay hi unhen azab say halak ker detay to yaqeenan yeh keh uthtay kay aey humaray perwerdigar tu ney humaray pass apna rasool kiyon na bheja? Kay hum teri aayaton ki tabeydaari kertay uss say pehlay kay hum zaleel o ruswa hotay
Keh dijiye! her aik anjam ka muntazir hai pus tum bhi intizar mein raho. Abhi abhi qata’an jaan lo gay kay raah raast walay kaun hain aur kaun raah yafta hain
